extracted.intended_audience: general readers, researchers, journalists seeking a consolidated overview of controversies involving Goldman Sachs
extracted.subtask_description: Create or consult a Wikipedia-style encyclopedia article that summarizes controversies, allegations, investigations, settlements, and criticism related to a single corporation (here: Goldman Sachs). The entry aggregates sourced incidents across time and subject areas (finance, legal, political, labor, commodities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Neutral point of view / dispute notice
rubrics_metrics.description: The neutrality of this article is disputed. Relevant discussion may be found on the talk page. Please do not remove this message until conditions to do so are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This banner indicates the article may not meet Wikipedia's neutral point-of-view policy. Editors and readers should consult the article's Talk page for discussion of issues and proposed fixes; the notice should remain until the underlying concerns are addressed (per linked guidance on 'how and when to remove this message').
